name: microplex-benchmark-data
description: A microbenchmark suite intended to measure fine-grained model behaviors across a set of compact, targeted tasks (MicroPlex). It focuses on assessing specific capabilities such as instruction-following, compositionality, or edge-case reasoning using short, concentrated examples. The benchmark is intended for rapid iteration and fine-grained comparison rather than large-scale generalization measurement.
reputation: Small, developer-oriented benchmark used by researchers and engineers for quick capability checks; not a widely standardized benchmark.
